items.summary: Sempra has given long term holders a solid ride over the past few years, yet the recent pullback and mixed earnings headlines leave a straightforward question hanging over the stock. Is today’s share price fully supported by what the business is earning right now, rather than by the story around it? items.title: Sempra (SRE) Lifts 2026 Guidance On A Valuation Story That Still Splits Opinion
